title: Framewise Kummer trace comparison for finite general-ring integration
statement: For a finite commutative ring A, positive annihilating exponents M and N with N dividing M, a Kummer comparison q,b satisfying FiniteGeneralRingKummerComparison, normalized twist data t,D at M, and a vector-bundle frame (V,eV) on S, the ordinary pullback to V of the composite of the vectorBundlePurityLower pullback of finiteGeneralRingLevelPower.hom with vectorBundleIntegration at N, followed by the ordinary unit pullback, equals vectorIntegrationLocalTrace at M for t,D,V,eV.

source.place: Proof (3), exponent independence; Kummer projective-line and ordered affine-line trace comparison on a frame.

proof.text: Expand vectorIntegrationLocalTrace into inverse-frame exchange, the normalized Tate coefficient comparison and the ordered affine counit.

Use the two clauses of FiniteGeneralRingKummerComparison to identify the projective-line Chern and unit columns under b; projective trace naturality and open-counit naturality, iterated in the prescribed coordinate order, identify the affine traces.
The resulting coefficient arrow is the ordinary pullback of finiteGeneralRingLevelPower.hom, yielding the displayed framewise equality.

proof_origin.place: Proof (3), Kummer exponent independence, local frame calculation.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteGeneralRingLocalTraceExponent
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (M N : ℕ) (hMpos : 0 < M) (hNpos : 0 < N) (hdiv : N ∣ M)
    (hM : (M : A) = 0) (hN : (N : A) = 0)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S]
    (hS : IsUnit (M : Γ(S, ⊤))) (hS' : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (d : ℕ) (F : S.Modules) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d]
    (q : S.rootsOfUnitySheaf M ⟶ S.rootsOfUnitySheaf N)
    (b : Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine S M A hM ≅
      Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine S N A hN)
    (hb : FiniteGeneralRingKummerComparison A M N hM hN S q b)
    (t : Etale.OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A M hM)
    (D : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (hT : IsUnit (M : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      Etale.OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum A M hM t T hT)
    (V : S.Opens) (eV : VectorBundleZeroSection.Trivialization S d F V) :
    (Etale.ordinaryFinitePullback A V.ι).map
        ((Etale.vectorBundlePurityLower A S d F).map
          ((Etale.ordinaryFinitePullback A (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d F)).map
            (finiteGeneralRingLevelPower A M N hM hN S b d).hom) ≫
          Etale.vectorBundleIntegration N hNpos A hN S hS' d F) ≫
        (Etale.ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A V.ι).hom =
      Etale.vectorIntegrationLocalTrace M hMpos A hM t D S hS d F V eV
